restaurants.zh: 蜀灌老味·传统川菜(内曹家巷店)
restaurants.address: 金牛区驷马桥街道内曹家巷1号附9号
restaurants.desc: A 24-year intangible heritage Sichuan restaurant with zero MSG and zero additives. The sauteed liver and kidney is the benchmark version in Chengdu — clean flavour, no gamey smell. Timber furniture and open kitchen.

dishes.en: Shuguan steamed pork with fermented paste

tips: 24 years old — ask staff about the intangible heritage certification
Zero MSG policy — the flavour comes from technique, not additives
Go for lunch to avoid the dinner queues

restaurants.zh: 有雲·传统川菜(西源集店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区清江中路1号2栋3F-05-07号
restaurants.desc: Gold Wutong China Restaurant Guide pick. The sauteed salted pork uses black truffle for lift. Private rooms with green terraces. One of the most complete traditional Sichuan menus in a refined setting.
tips: Gold Wutong China Restaurant Guide recognition
Private rooms with green terraces — worth requesting
The black truffle salted pork is the dish that separates this from ordinary Sichuan restaurants

restaurants.address: 锦江区人民南路2段80号锦江宾馆贵宾楼4楼
restaurants.desc: Inside the landmark Jinjiang Hotel, open for over 60 years. The chicken bean flower (ji douhua) requires exceptional knife skill and is considered the most technically difficult dish in Sichuan cooking. Ideal for introducing foreign guests to serious Sichuan cuisine.
tips: Open 60+ years — a genuine Chengdu institution
The chicken bean flower is the most technically demanding dish in Sichuan cooking — order it
Good for introducing foreign guests to proper Sichuan cuisine

restaurants.zh: 轩轩的竹韵小院(金沙店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区金沙遗址路11号
restaurants.desc: A garden courtyard restaurant near Jinsha Museum. The snow flower chicken tofu (xuehua ji nao) is an endangered Sichuan technique — silky white curds of blended chicken in clear broth. The bamboo garden setting is one of the most peaceful in Chengdu.
tips: Near Jinsha Museum — combine with a morning visit
The snow flower chicken tofu is an endangered technique — one of very few places that still make it
The bamboo garden is beautiful in the afternoon light

restaurants.address: 锦江区菱窠西路9号（东门市井内）
restaurants.desc: Rooted in Li Jierens 1930s restaurant tradition. The Republican-era red brick and carved wood décor is museum-quality. The snow flower chicken tofu and the smoked rabbit are the two dishes most worth ordering.
tips: Inside Dongmen Shijing heritage area — allow time to explore
Traced to Li Jierens 1930s restaurant — a genuine piece of Chengdu culinary history
The smoked rabbit uses a traditional orchid-fragrance technique

restaurants.zh: 蘸四海·传统自贡菜(中坝店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区光华北三路238号1栋附133号
restaurants.desc: Traditional Zigong cuisine — a distinct Sichuan regional style known for its unique sour-and-spicy character. The fire-exploded double crispy (tripe and kidney) is technically impressive. Outdoor seating on the terrace.

dishes.en: Pork head and white pork platter

tips: Zigong cuisine is a distinct regional style — different from standard Chengdu Sichuan
The fire-exploded double crispy must be eaten immediately — the heat is part of the dish
Mahjong rooms on the second floor — very Chengdu

restaurants.address: 武侯区簇桥街道龙井南街48号
restaurants.desc: The aesthetic of a 1970s state canteen — red lanterns, family-style tables, private rooms — and the cooking to match. The small-stir yellow beef and the mapo tofu are Sichuan home cooking at its most honest.
tips: The canteen aesthetic is part of the charm — lean into it
At ¥36 average, exceptional value for honest Sichuan cooking
The dry-stirred beef and the mapo tofu are the two dishes to order

restaurants.zh: 北湖野肆·柴火鸡·露营烤肉(北湖公园店)
restaurants.address: 成华区湖景一路北湖生态公园萤火竹舍隔壁
restaurants.desc: Inside Beihu Ecological Park, a campsite-style restaurant where whole chickens are slow-cooked in a wood-fired earth stove. The lakeside setting with bamboo groves is the most outdoor dining experience in Chengdu.
tips: Inside Beihu Ecological Park — combine with a walk around the lake
The firewood chicken takes 40 minutes — order it immediately
Campsite-style seating outdoors — bring a jacket in cooler months

restaurants.address: 金牛区外曹家巷26号附15号
restaurants.desc: 2026 must-eat list finalist with over 10 years of history. The brain tofu and the fragrant pork ribs have cult followings. A genuine neighbourhood Sichuan restaurant without any tourist pretension.
tips: 2026 must-eat list finalist — worth the trip
The brain tofu sounds confronting but tastes silky and mild
Over 10 years old — a genuine neighbourhood institution

restaurants.zh: 正反面(成都面馆50强金沙店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区金阳路148号
restaurants.desc: Top 50 noodle shop in Chengdu. The beef noodle broth is prepared overnight using a technique that produces a clear but deeply flavoured stock. The open kitchen with named chefs is unusual for a noodle shop of this price.
tips: Top 50 noodle shop in Chengdu — the overnight broth is what separates it
Named chefs in the open kitchen — unusual at this price point
Near Jinsha Museum — combine with a morning visit

restaurants.zh: 天府兔·非遗兔头(春熙路店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区春熙路街道大业路74号
restaurants.desc: Intangible cultural heritage rabbit head — a quintessentially Chengdu street snack. The cold-spiced rabbit head is gnawed with a specific technique locals learn as children. The garlic rabbit head is the mildest entry point for first-timers.
tips: Rabbit head is a quintessential Chengdu experience — approach with an open mind
The garlic version is the mildest — good for first-timers
Near Chunxi Road — easy to combine with shopping

restaurants.zh: 旧城小院老成都传统小吃(华润·LaVie峰锦店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区通锦桥路88-90号
restaurants.desc: Traditional Chengdu snack set in a retro courtyard design. The san he ni (sesame, peanut and walnut paste) is a dying Old Chengdu tradition. Full open kitchen design with the chef-owner serving personally.

dishes.en: Sweet noodles with broad bean sauce

tips: The three harmony paste is a dying Old Chengdu tradition — do not skip it
Chef-owner serves personally — ask about the recipes
Retro courtyard design makes every dish photogenic

restaurants.address: 锦江区牛王庙巷91号附1号
restaurants.desc: Number one on Jiuyanqiao noodle rankings. The sea mushroom wonton uses an unusual dried mushroom broth base that gives it a clean umami depth. Retro old Chengdu atmosphere with strong nostalgia aesthetic.
tips: Number one on Jiuyanqiao noodle rankings
The sea mushroom wonton is the most unusual item — the dried mushroom broth is extraordinary
Strong retro old Chengdu atmosphere — great for photos

restaurants.address: 青羊区少城路12号人民公园内紫薇阁
restaurants.desc: Founded in the Guangxu era of the Qing dynasty — over 130 years old. Shares the classical teahouse setting of Renmin Park with Heming Tea House. The red oil wontons here are the benchmark version that all others are compared to.

dishes.en: Traditional sweet broad bean sauce noodles

tips: Founded in the Guangxu era — over 130 years old
Inside Renmin Park — combine with tea at Heming Tea House next door
The red oil wontons here are the benchmark version — every other version in Chengdu descends from this

restaurants.address: 锦江区东较场街118号
restaurants.desc: A former government guesthouse canteen from the last century. Blue floral tablecloths, old photographs and a deliberately unchanged decor create a time-warp experience. The crispy rice pork and the liver-kidney stir-fry are the dishes that old Chengdu residents come back for.
tips: Former government guesthouse — the decor has not changed in decades
Blue floral tablecloths and old photos make every corner photogenic
The crispy rice pork is the most technically interesting dish — the rice crackles when the pork hits it

restaurants.address: 青羊区兴禅寺街与帘官公所街交叉口西60米
restaurants.desc: Traditional Chengdu home cooking at its most unpretentious. The liver-kidney stir-fry here has zero gamey smell — a rarity. The dry-fried green beans are cooked until the skin blisters.
tips: Genuinely local — no tourist pretension
The liver-kidney stir-fry has zero gamey smell — this is the quality benchmark
The dry-fried green beans are blistered until the skin wrinkles — the correct technique

restaurants.address: 成华区跳蹬河街道建设南路163号(东郊记忆旁)
restaurants.desc: Inside the Dongjiao Memory creative park. The eight trigrams mural wall and vintage green train carriage make it one of the most photogenic noodle houses in Chengdu. The pea-and-mince noodles are made with a hand-ground sauce.
tips: Inside Dongjiao Memory creative park — combine with a walk through the art spaces
The eight trigrams mural wall is the most photogenic spot
At ¥17 average, exceptional value for the setting

restaurants.zh: 胡记小吃店(建设路54号住宅小区店)
restaurants.address: 成华区猛追湾横街建设路54号小区老7栋三单元一楼
restaurants.desc: Number one on Chenghua district noodle rankings. The plain-chilli mince sauce noodles are considered the ceiling version in Chengdu — the sauce is hand-ground and the sesame paste ratio is precise. Inside a residential compound — as local as it gets.
tips: Number one on Chenghua noodle rankings
Inside a residential compound — allow time to find it and embrace the local atmosphere
The plain chilli mince sauce noodles are considered the best version in Chengdu

restaurants.zh: 源源小吃店(锦华路一段店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区东湖街道锦华路一段275号
restaurants.desc: A 20-year-old neighbourhood noodle shop preserving old Chengdu noodle traditions. At just ¥16 average, the pork rib noodle soup is a meal in itself — the ribs are braised until they fall off the bone.
tips: 20 years old — a genuine neighbourhood institution
The pork rib noodle is a full meal at ¥16 — extraordinary value
Near Donghu area — a pleasant neighbourhood to walk

restaurants.address: 都江堰市灌口街道伏龙社区江西街4号
restaurants.desc: Intangible heritage qiaojiao beef — a Leshan tradition of beef and offal cooked in a communal broth pot. The walls are covered in Hong Kong and Taiwan celebrity photographs from the 1980s. The bowl of blood curd in fragrant broth is the most talked-about dish.
tips: The celebrity photograph walls from the 1980s are a fascinating time capsule
The blood curd bowl sounds alarming but tastes clean and delicate
Intangible heritage certification — a genuine cultural dining experience

restaurants.zh: 三牛九传统手工串串(文星店)
restaurants.address: 双流区西航港街道川大路三段125号
restaurants.desc: Traditional hand-threaded skewer hotpot — a Chengdu format where bamboo skewers are dipped individually into a communal spiced broth. The brain tofu skewer is the most adventurous order. The red oil signature broth uses a multi-day preparation.
tips: Hand-threaded skewers — the bamboo skewers are threaded to order
The brain tofu skewer is the most unusual order — mild and silky once you try it
Count your skewers at the end — payment is per skewer

restaurants.address: 都江堰市青城水街南段133号
restaurants.desc: The Dujiangyan branch of the intangible heritage qiaojiao beef institution. The steamed minced beef is packed into a small bowl with a distinct chilli-lard aroma. Near Qingcheng Mountain — a natural pairing after a morning hike.

dishes.en: Steamed minced beef with rice flour

tips: Near Qingcheng Mountain — ideal lunch after a morning hike
The steamed minced beef is packed with chilli-lard aroma
Ask for extra dipping sauce — it transforms every dish

restaurants.zh: 巴蜀大将火锅(太古里店)
restaurants.address: 青羊区少城街道琴台路60号
restaurants.desc: Five consecutive years on the must-eat list. The tallow broth here is the benchmark for Chengdu hotpot — aromatic, spicy and clear. The red sugar glutinous rice cake is the signature dessert, arriving in a cast iron pan.
tips: Five consecutive must-eat list appearances — the tallow broth is the benchmark
The red sugar glutinous rice cake arrives sizzling in cast iron — order it early
Traditional elegant décor — more refined than the average hotpot restaurant

restaurants.address: 锦江区东大街下东大街段2号2层
restaurants.desc: Near Chunxi Road metro. The hanging dragon beef (diaolong ban) is cut fresh daily and limited in quantity — regulars arrive early specifically for it. The Sichuan-heritage décor makes every corner photogenic.
tips: The hanging dragon beef is cut fresh daily and sells out — arrive before 6pm
Near Chunxi Road — very convenient for tourists
The Sichuan heritage décor is beautiful for photos

restaurants.address: 青羊区奎星楼街长顺中街99号
restaurants.desc: A regular on the Chengdu hotpot queuing chart. The slow-braised beef (pa pa niurou) falls off at a touch. Retro old Chongqing street atmosphere with lanterns and timber furniture.
tips: Consistently on the Chengdu hotpot queuing chart — expect a wait
The slow-braised beef falls off at a touch — the benchmark tender beef experience
Retro old Chongqing lantern décor — very photogenic

restaurants.address: 锦江区华兴正街77号附3号
restaurants.desc: A heritage hotpot restaurant blending courtyard, old Shanghai and Republican-era décor. The hand-shredded fresh buffalo tripe is prepared tableside. One of the most visually striking hotpot restaurants in Chengdu.
tips: The hand-shredded tripe is prepared tableside — watch the technique
Heritage décor blending three architectural styles — beautiful for photos
The original tallow red broth is the purest expression of Chengdu hotpot

restaurants.address: 武侯区高远一路15号7322创意园区C6
restaurants.desc: Chongqing water hotpot technique — seven parts water to three parts oil — in a private courtyard setting with floor-to-ceiling windows. The duck blood is silky-tender from the lower-oil broth.
tips: Chongqing water hotpot is different from standard Chengdu hotpot — lighter broth, more delicate
Private rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and tiled roofs
The duck blood in the lower-oil broth is silkier than in standard hotpot

restaurants.address: 锦江区琉璃路678号付2号（翡翠天地内）
restaurants.desc: A ten-year institution with a winding garden courtyard. The bamboo shoots (sun ke) and the red sand are the unusual dishes that separate this from standard hotpot. The setting evokes old Chengdu leisure culture.
tips: The garden courtyard setting evokes genuine old Chengdu leisure culture
The bamboo shoot fish and red sand are unique to this restaurant
Ten-year institution — the décor has a patina of genuine age

restaurants.zh: 老马扎市井小火锅(都江堰古城店)
restaurants.address: 武侯区二环路南三段20号
restaurants.desc: A historic brand carrying three generations of Chengdu memories. The standalone heritage commercial building with classical Chinese décor has become a landmark. The old mum red tallow broth is the house recipe.
tips: Three generations of Chengdu memories — a genuine institution
The old mum beef is thick-cut wagyu that melts immediately
Heritage standalone building — worth photographing from the street

restaurants.zh: 渝少侠·熊猫小院火锅(武侯祠店)
restaurants.address: 都江堰市天维街84号附16号
restaurants.desc: Near Wuhou Shrine. Enamel bowls, small wooden stools and panda installations create a playful market atmosphere. The signature tofu flower beef broth is the mildest entry point for those new to Sichuan hotpot.
tips: Near Wuhou Shrine — combine with a visit to the Three Kingdoms museum
The tofu flower beef broth is the mildest Sichuan hotpot option — good for spice-sensitive visitors
The matcha jasmine ice tofu flower is the best dessert to end the meal

restaurants.zh: 山苗苗鲜牛肉小火锅(成都太古里店)
restaurants.address: 武侯区武侯祠大街244号
restaurants.desc: In a new Chinese-style courtyard near Wuhou Shrine with panda installations. The hanging dragon is fresh-cut daily. The panda coconut milk jelly dessert is the most photographed dish in the restaurant.
tips: Panda coconut milk jelly is the most photographed dish — order it regardless
Near Wuhou Shrine — one of the best located hotpot restaurants for tourists
The hanging dragon is fresh-cut daily — go before 7pm

restaurants.zh: 黔夺夺贵州酸汤火锅(成都万象城店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区中纱帽街8号地下一层M026
restaurants.desc: Inside Taikoo Li basement. Guizhou sour broth hotpot — a completely different style from Sichuan — using a fermented tomato base that is tangy without being spicy. Vegetables and mushrooms are self-service.
tips: Inside Taikoo Li — very convenient for tourists in central Chengdu
Guizhou sour broth is NOT spicy — good for visitors who cannot eat Sichuan spice
The sour broth is genuinely tangy and refreshing — different from anything else in Chengdu

restaurants.zh: 继熙家·贵州酸汤小火锅(成都IFS店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区IFS国际金融中心LG1层食通天
restaurants.desc: Wild mushroom and free-range chicken hotpot in a forest-themed interior inside IFS mall. The highland wild mushrooms include jianshouqing — a variety that only grows above 3000 metres. The fried rice finish to the meal is extraordinary.
tips: Highland wild mushrooms include varieties from above 3000m — genuinely rare
The fried rice finish to the meal uses the leftover broth — do not skip it
Forest-themed interior is one of the most beautiful in Chengdu

restaurants.zh: 蘑界·野生菌火锅(成都首店)
restaurants.address: 金牛区营门口街道西顺街399号西宸天街购物中心5楼29号
restaurants.desc: Chengdu flagship store of the wild mushroom hotpot concept. The beef bone clear broth base lets the mushroom flavour dominate. Staff proactively help guests manage the beef cooking time — a sign of genuine service quality.
tips: Staff help manage the beef cooking time — let them guide you
The five-flower tendon and spoon meat are the premium cuts — order both
Independent private rooms and a small garden

restaurants.zh: 八合里潮汕鲜牛肉火锅(成都西宸天街店)
restaurants.address: 郫都区合作路89号19栋1楼附110号
restaurants.desc: The Chaoshan fresh beef hotpot style — clear broth, ultra-fresh beef, cooked in seconds. Different from Sichuan hotpot — no spice, pure beef flavour. The Chaoshan dipping sauce (sha cha jiang) is the essential accompaniment.

dishes.en: Old Chengdu red sugar ice jelly

tips: Chaoshan style is NOT spicy — a good alternative to Sichuan hotpot
Cook the beef for 5–10 seconds only
The Chaoshan satay dipping sauce is essential — do not use the standard Sichuan sauce

restaurants.zh: 神鲜市井·肥肠鸡·鲜兔火锅(时代天街店)
restaurants.address: 成华区双林南支路38号
restaurants.desc: Guizhou sour broth hotpot in a Miao ethnic minority-themed interior that feels like a Guizhou village. The sour broth is naturally fermented for 365 days — longer than most other restaurants. The crispy potato taro cake is the signature snack.

dishes.en: Crispy fried pork lard potato cake

tips: The sour broth is fermented for 365 days — longer than most
The interior looks like a Guizhou Miao village — great for photos
The crispy potato taro cake is the unexpected highlight — order it as a snack

restaurants.address: 青羊区琴台路附近
restaurants.desc: A classic Chengdu hotpot institution on the historic Qintai Road. The tallow broth has a clean, pure spice that does not overwhelm the ingredients. Traditional Sichuan interior with opera masks and red lanterns.
tips: On historic Qintai Road — combine with an evening walk
The tallow broth is clean and aromatic — not overwhelming
Traditional Sichuan opera mask décor makes every corner photogenic

restaurants.address: 锦江区龙王庙正街13号
restaurants.desc: A 100-year-old camphor tree grows through the roof of this yellow-timber bistro near Jiuyanqiao. The Yunnan-Sichuan fusion cooking blends Dai flavours with Sichuan heat. The taro flatbread has a crispy exterior and glutinous centre.

dishes.en: Simao wild herb stir-fried black chicken

tips: The 100-year camphor tree growing through the roof is the most striking architectural feature
The taro flatbread is the must-order — crispy outside, glutinous inside
Near Jiuyanqiao — a good evening area for drinks after dinner

restaurants.address: 锦江区中纱帽街8号成都太古里中里2层2237号
restaurants.desc: A wabi-sabi bamboo courtyard inside Taikoo Li. The menu follows the 24 solar terms. The jasmine tea curd and the chestnut roast chicken are the two dishes that have given it a devoted following. A Chengdu take on the slow-dining movement.
tips: Inside Taikoo Li — very easy to access from Chunxi Road
The menu changes with the 24 solar terms — ask what is seasonal
The bamboo courtyard is one of the most serene spots in central Chengdu

restaurants.address: 高新区交子大道500号誉峰遇见A座109-110商铺
restaurants.desc: Chengdu representative of the atmosphere wine bistro format. The Sichuan carbonara (Sichuan mince sauce with egg pasta) has become a cult dish. The crispy ox tongue has a shatter-like skin with a silky centre.
tips: The Sichuan carbonara is the cult dish — order it without question
Green-toned interior is very flattering for photos
Transitions to bar mode after 9pm — the atmosphere completely changes

restaurants.address: 武侯区玉林街道棕苑巷2号2楼
restaurants.desc: In Yulin neighbourhood — the artistic heart of Chengdu. The outdoor lawn and the second-floor loft interior are both equally good settings. The Dai-style sour spicy tilapia is the most talked-about dish — a Yunnan technique rarely found in Chengdu.
tips: In Yulin — the most artistic neighbourhood in Chengdu
The outdoor lawn is beautiful in good weather
The Dai-style tilapia uses a Yunnan technique rarely found in Chengdu

restaurants.address: 武侯区玉林八巷9号附1号
restaurants.desc: Open kitchen studio in Yulin with a focused creative menu that changes regularly. The beef tartare and the charcoal ox tongue with unagi sauce are the flagship dishes. One of the most serious small restaurants in Chengdu.

dishes.en: Charcoal ox tongue with unagi sauce and maitake
dishes.zh: 炭烤牛舌鳗鱼汁烤舞茸

dishes.en: Aged small amberjack with roe and aged vinegar butter
dishes.zh: 熟成小马友鱼籽糟粕醋黄油汁

dishes.en: Butter potato rice with aged chicken leg
dishes.zh: 黄油土豆焖饭熟成鸡腿肉

dishes.en: Baby squid with sweet peas and aubergine toast
dishes.zh: 小管鱿鱼甜蜜豆茄子泥吐司

tips: Open kitchen — you can watch every dish being made
The beef tartare is the most refined version in Chengdu
In Yulin — the most relaxed neighbourhood for a long dinner

restaurants.address: 锦江区油篓街38号附2号
restaurants.desc: Harbour-style industrial interior that transitions from restaurant to bar after 9pm. The palace flower brewed ribs combine Sichuan flower pepper with an osmanthus reduction. The hundred prawn dish arrives as a tower.
tips: Transitions to bar mode at 9pm — the atmosphere completely transforms
The harbour-style industrial décor is very photogenic at night
The osmanthus brewed ribs are the signature creative Sichuan dish

restaurants.zh: 遇见你·创意融合菜(桐梓林店)
restaurants.address: 武侯区桐梓林北路2号26楼
restaurants.desc: 26th floor views over Renmin South Road. Fully private room dining with panoramic windows. The M9 wagyu short rib and the foie gras are the headline luxury items. One of the best high-rise dining experiences in Chengdu at this price point.
tips: 26th floor — go at dusk for the best view over Renmin South Road
All private room dining — suitable for confidential business dinners
Book at least a week ahead

restaurants.address: 锦江区华兴东街16号附2号
restaurants.desc: Creative Sichuan with a natural wine programme inside Taikoo Li. The plum-braised ribs have an unusual sour-sweet profile from the hawthorn reduction. The triple-treasure ice tofu flower is the most refined dessert.

dishes.en: Fourth-generation tofu with beef spinal cord

tips: Inside Taikoo Li — the most convenient creative Sichuan restaurant for tourists
The fourth-generation tofu with spinal cord is the most unusual dish — order it
Natural wine programme — ask staff for a pairing recommendation

restaurants.address: 锦江区锦官驿街道玉成街14号附5号
restaurants.desc: Japanese-Sichuan fusion in a timber-and-stone interior. The red-three-chop spicy beef taco uses Yunnan fermented chilli as the base. The Thai bread prawn curry is the crowd-pleaser. A very photogenic space with warm natural light.
tips: Inside Taikoo Li — easy to combine with shopping
The red-three-chop beef taco is the signature Yunnan-Sichuan fusion dish
Warm natural light throughout — good for photos at any time of day

restaurants.address: 锦江区莲花西路150号
restaurants.desc: A light-filled green space restaurant near Dongmen. The M5 wagyu pan-seared with zhangsu chilli is the signature — local chilli with premium beef. The black truffle mushroom crispy lard rice is the most comforting dish on the menu.

dishes.en: House butter with walnut sourdough toast
dishes.zh: 自制特色黄油配核桃面包片

dishes.en: Seared M5 wagyu with zhangsu chilli
Black truffle mushroom crispy lard rice

tips: The zhangsu chilli is a local Sichuan variety — very different from standard Sichuan chilli
The black truffle crispy lard rice is the comfort dish of the menu
Green and well-lit interior — good for photos at any time of day

restaurants.address: 锦江区玉树路58神奇空间二栋
restaurants.desc: Medieval European interior near the river in Jinjiang. The M4 tomahawk steak and the spicy crayfish pasta are at opposite ends of the menu but both excel. The foie gras is seared tableside.

dishes.en: Wild mushroom fatty beef fried rice
M4 tomahawk steak with seasonal vegetables

tips: Medieval European interior is unique in Chengdu
The M4 tomahawk is the theatrical centrepiece — suitable for two people
Foie gras seared tableside — let the server do it properly

restaurants.zh: 大创·融合料理(玉林路店)
restaurants.address: 武侯区玉林街道玉林南街28号
restaurants.desc: A standalone courtyard with a Japanese garden design in Yulin. The Southeast Asian influences in the cooking are genuine — the green papaya salad uses authentic fish sauce and the moon prawn cake is a Thai street food classic elevated.
tips: Independent Japanese garden courtyard — beautiful in all seasons
The green papaya salad uses authentic fish sauce — genuinely Thai technique
In Yulin — combine with a walk through the neighbourhood

restaurants.address: 锦江区宏济中路39号附17号
restaurants.desc: A three-floor standalone Art Deco villa in old Shanghai style near Jiuyanqiao. The yellow croaker is the seasonal hero — sourced fresh from Zhoushan. The kung pao crispy prawn is the most creative take on a classic Sichuan dish.
tips: Three-floor Art Deco villa — worth exploring all three floors
The Zhoushan yellow croaker is seasonal (spring-summer) — the freshest fish in Chengdu
The kung pao crispy prawn is the most creative Sichuan dish on the menu

restaurants.address: 青羊区贝森北路3号贝森花园别墅14栋
restaurants.desc: Inside a private villa in Beisen Garden. The tea fragrance duck requires 24-hour pre-order. The Sichuan-style pasta is the most-talked about fusion dish — Sichuan chilli oil replaces the standard tomato sauce.
tips: Inside a private villa — allow time to find it
The tea fragrance duck must be ordered 24 hours ahead
The Sichuan pasta uses Sichuan chilli oil in place of tomato sauce — surprisingly excellent

restaurants.zh: 别屋 ANOTHER ROOM·亚洲手作(万象城店)
restaurants.address: 成华区双庆路8号成都万象城A馆L5
restaurants.desc: Warm amber lighting and handcraft aesthetic in Mixc Mall. The caramel salmon poke bowl and the Angus short rib sour broth hotpot occupy different corners of the flavour spectrum — both work. The lychee coconut shaved ice is the most photographed dessert.

dishes.en: Angus short rib sour broth hotpot
Sugared tree tomato and longan coconut shaved ice
dishes.zh: 糖渍树番茄与龙眼椰子雪花冰

dishes.en: Hainan pineapple sauce charcoal pork rib
dishes.zh: 海南菠萝酱炙烤猪肋条

tips: Warm amber lighting makes every dish look beautiful
The Angus sour broth hotpot is the most substantial dish — good to share
The lychee coconut shaved ice is the most photographed dessert

restaurants.zh: Silver pot·银锅现代川菜(悠方店)
restaurants.address: 高新区交子大道300号悠方ICP写字楼M6座5层
restaurants.desc: The flagship fine dining expression of modern Sichuan cuisine. Observatory private rooms overlook the twin towers. The tribute pepper smoked pigeon and the earth kiln beef are the two dishes most representative of what this kitchen can do.

dishes.en: Claypot tribute pepper leaf smoked pigeon

tips: Book 3+ weeks ahead — very limited seating
The tribute pepper is a rare Sichuan ingredient with a uniquely floral heat
Observatory rooms overlook the twin towers — go at dusk for the best light

restaurants.address: 锦江区青莲上街5号附2号
restaurants.desc: Japanese-aesthetic all-day bistro near Jiuyanqiao. The cream curry udon and the wagyu cheese croquette are the comfort dishes that keep regulars coming back. The natural timber décor creates warm, flattering light.

dishes.en: Roasted chilli meat cake egg fried rice

dishes.zh: 牛油果蟹肉土豆泥沙拉

tips: Natural timber décor creates warm, flattering light throughout
The cream curry udon is the most comforting dish on the menu
Near Jiuyanqiao — a good area for an evening walk after dinner

restaurants.address: 青羊区黄瓦街56号院附3号
restaurants.desc: Vintage French interior near Huangwa Street. The black truffle foie gras rice with soft egg is the most complex dish. The Earl Grey peach cheese salad is a surprisingly elegant combination. Transitions to cocktail bar mode after 9pm.

dishes.en: Flamed black truffle foie gras rice with soft egg
dishes.zh: 火炙黑松露鹅肝拌饭配溏心蛋

dishes.en: Earl Grey peach cream cheese salad
dishes.zh: 伯爵茶渍桃子乳酪沙拉
吞拿鱼牛油果烟熏牛舌
蒜香苹果烤伊比利亚黑猪肋排

dishes.en: Korean spicy cream braised ox small intestine
dishes.zh: 朝鲜风味辣奶油烩烤牛小肠

tips: Transitions to cocktail bar after 9pm — the playlist also changes
The black truffle foie gras rice is the most complex dish on the menu
Near Huangwa Street — a quiet neighbourhood with old Chengdu character

restaurants.address: 青白江区大同街道凤凰大道二段932号
restaurants.desc: A cooking studio-style space with Japanese-Chinese landscaping. The Sichuan spicy prawn tail baked rice is the most popular dish — it combines Sichuan chilli paste with the Thai technique of baking rice in a coconut shell.

dishes.en: Sichuan spicy prawn tail baked rice

tips: The Sichuan prawn tail baked rice is the signature creative fusion dish
Japanese-Chinese garden landscaping — beautiful for photos
Out of the city centre but accessible by metro to Qingbaijiang

restaurants.zh: PoDo in PoDo 创意料理(春熙路群光店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区春熙路街道群光广场9楼
restaurants.desc: Korean-influenced creative restaurant on the 9th floor of Grandview Plaza on Chunxi Road. The stinky tofu spicy chicken feet is the most surprising crowd-pleaser. Soft flattering lighting throughout.
tips: 9th floor with views over Chunxi Road — go in the evening for the best atmosphere
The stinky tofu chicken feet is the unexpected crowd-pleaser — order it
On Chunxi Road — very convenient for tourists

restaurants.zh: 无早小食神奇空间庭院版
restaurants.address: 武侯区玉林街道
restaurants.desc: The neighbourhood of Yulin has developed a cluster of courtyard restaurants that embody the Chengdu slow-life philosophy. Quiet lanes, courtyard seating and a pace of eating that contrasts with the busy commercial areas.
tips: The Yulin neighbourhood is the most pleasant for an evening stroll in Chengdu
Courtyard restaurants here are best visited on weekday evenings
The pace of eating is slower here — budget 2+ hours for a full meal

restaurants.zh: Lets Taipei 非常烘焙(太古里店)
restaurants.address: 锦江区中纱帽街8号成都远洋太古里M层M028b号
restaurants.desc: Inside Taikoo Li basement. The flying fish roe baguette fills a crisp thin French baguette with a generous layer of flying fish roe — a combination that has created queues since opening. The black truffle version is the premium option.
tips: Inside Taikoo Li — very easy to access
The flying fish roe baguette has created queues since opening — worth the wait
The black truffle version is ¥10 more and worth it

restaurants.address: 武侯区芳草街27号附1号
restaurants.desc: Near Yulin metro, this Japanese-inspired bakery makes its signature products from rice flour — producing a soft glutinous texture quite unlike wheat bread. The nori glutinous rice bread has a savoury-sweet contrast that is addictive.
tips: The rice bread has a texture unlike wheat bread — soft and slightly chewy
At just ¥19 average, one of the best value bakeries in Chengdu
Near Yulin metro — very easy to access

restaurants.address: 武侯区桐梓林路6号
restaurants.desc: A glass house wrapped in trees in the Tongzilin expat neighbourhood. Free tasting samples offered throughout the day. The fig twist stick gets denser and chewier as you eat it — one of the most satisfying breads in Chengdu.
tips: Free tasting samples throughout the day — try before you buy
In the expat Tongzilin neighbourhood — good area for an afternoon walk
The glass house in the trees is very beautiful on a clear day

restaurants.address: 高新区交子大道300号悠方购物中心1层179号
restaurants.desc: Industrial-chic patisserie in Youfang Mall near the twin towers. The not-an-egg-tart (bu shi dan ta) has a flowing heart filling that is intentionally opposite to the set custard of a traditional egg tart. High-end ingredients including porcini, black truffle and free-range eggs.
tips: The not-an-egg-tart must be eaten immediately — the flowing heart sets after a few minutes
Outdoor seating overlooks the twin towers
Industrial-chic décor with floor-to-ceiling windows — great photos

restaurants.zh: 新加坡妈妈烤包 Roti Mum
restaurants.address: 金牛区花牌坊街40号C栋1-7号无里创意工厂内
restaurants.desc: The original Singapore-to-Malaysia roti bun concept that has been operating in China for over a decade. The freshly baked roti has a crispy shell with a soft, milk-scented interior. Inside the Wuli Creative Factory.
tips: The original roti bun must be eaten hot — the shell softens quickly
Inside Wuli Creative Factory — allow time to explore the creative park
Over 10 years in China — one of the most established foreign bakery concepts

restaurants.address: 锦江区中纱帽街8号太古里东广场M层M049号
restaurants.desc: Inside Taikoo Li with a fresh coastal blue-and-white interior. The Greenland croissant has a green matcha heart and a caramelised exterior. Free lemon water is served to all customers. Allergen information is clearly labelled.
tips: Inside Taikoo Li — very easy to access
The Greenland croissant has a flowing matcha heart — eat it immediately
Free lemon water is a nice touch — ask if not offered

restaurants.address: 成华区双福一路58号附17号万象城商圈
restaurants.desc: Near Mixc Mall metro station. The rice bread uses premium short-grain rice and produces a chew unlike any wheat bread. The red wine hazelnut cinnamon roll is the most complex item on the menu.

dishes.en: Seaweed salted egg yolk pretzel stick
Purple rice salted egg cream rice bread

tips: The red wine hazelnut cinnamon roll is the most complex item
Near Mixc Mall metro — very convenient
The rice bread chew is distinctive — completely unlike wheat bread

restaurants.address: 锦江区点将台街83号
restaurants.desc: Korean-aesthetic bagel shop near Jiuyanqiao. The rose lychee cream cheese iced bagel and the osmanthus taro cheese iced bagel are the signature items. Free rebake service offered for takeaway bagels. A free thin pretzel is given with every order.
tips: Free thin pretzel with every order
Rebake service for takeaway — ask at the counter
Near Jiuyanqiao — very pleasant area for a morning walk

restaurants.address: 锦江区天仙桥南路8号附10号
restaurants.desc: American retro industrial interior with taxidermy and steampunk décor. The butter dirty coffee is the signature drink — saturated with cultured butter that slowly melts into the espresso. Queues form on weekends.
tips: The butter dirty coffee has queues on weekends — go on a weekday morning
Taxidermy and steampunk décor is unlike anything else in Chengdu
The cultured butter slowly melts — drink it before it fully incorporates for best effect

restaurants.address: 锦江区锦官驿街道镗钯街53号
restaurants.desc: New Chinese style interior near Taikoo Li with warm amber lighting. The building lotus grand slam is a bowl with six different lotus-based textures. The taro sweet soup uses fresh taro with an unusually clean sweetness.
tips: The northern lotus grand slam is the signature — six different lotus textures
Near Taikoo Li — very easy to access
New Chinese décor with warm lighting is very flattering for food photos

restaurants.address: 成华区望平街25号附16号
restaurants.desc: A warm timber-walled dessert counter on Wangping Street near Dongjiao Memory. The mochi here is handmade daily — chewy without being dense. The rose peach jelly coconut sweet soup is the most fragrant item.

dishes.en: Mochi glutinous flatbread bean noodle iced sweet ball

tips: The mochi is handmade daily — the freshest version in this area
Near Dongjiao Memory creative park — combine with a visit
The rose peach jelly coconut soup is the most fragrant item on the menu

restaurants.address: 锦江区中纱帽街8号成都太古里地下1层M051C号
restaurants.desc: Inside Taikoo Li basement. The Yulan ice is the most visually striking dessert in Chengdu — a magnolia flower sculpted from ice cream. The glazed night uses a matcha shell with a dark chocolate interior. Packaging is considered the most gift-worthy in Chengdu.
tips: The Yulan magnolia ice cream is the most visually striking dessert in Chengdu
Packaging is considered the best gift option in the city
Inside Taikoo Li — buy a gift box before leaving Chengdu

restaurants.address: 武侯区科华北路56号附12号
restaurants.desc: Near Sichuan University. The mango durian blood glutinous rice mille crepe uses fresh fruit and animal cream — noticeably lighter than mass-produced versions. The six-inch cake at ¥55 is one of the best value cakes in Chengdu.

dishes.en: Mango durian blood glutinous rice mille crepe
Taro pork floss mochi lava mille crepe
dishes.zh: 芋泥肉松麻薯流心千层

tips: Near Sichuan University — a genuine student neighbourhood
The fresh mango durian mille crepe uses fresh fruit — not jam
Six-inch at ¥55 is exceptional value for animal-cream mille crepe

restaurants.zh: 如思台北甜品店(玉林西路店)
restaurants.address: 武侯区芳草街街道白云街2号附8
restaurants.desc: A Taipei-nostalgic dessert shop run by a Taiwanese owner. The jumping strawberry ice uses popping candy for a theatrical texture contrast. Taiwan film posters and stamps cover every wall. The taro bean flower pudding is a Taiwanese comfort classic.

dishes.en: Missing you red bean milk ice

tips: Run by a Taiwanese owner — the recipes are genuinely from Taipei
The jumping strawberry ice uses popping candy — a fun texture contrast
Taiwan film poster décor makes every corner photogenic

restaurants.address: 武侯区高阳路1906创意园区b19左侧
restaurants.desc: A factory-converted creative park space designed with a Central Saint Martins aesthetic. The transparent studio kitchen is visible from the seating area. The rice cream cake has a mochi layer inside. One of the most seriously designed dessert spaces in Chengdu.

dishes.en: Iroha matcha red bean souffle tart
dishes.zh: 五十铃抹茶红豆舒芙蕾挞

tips: Transparent kitchen — you can watch every dessert being made
Central Saint Martins aesthetic is unique in Chengdu
Private room available — good for a special afternoon tea

restaurants.address: 高新区天府二街777号REGULAR源野西花园负一层
restaurants.desc: French-trained patisserie using rare and specific provenance ingredients — Tahiti vanilla, Japanese yuzu, white peach from France. The guava strawberry Japanese yuzu mousse is the seasonal signature. Outdoor seating overlooks a planted garden.

dishes.zh: 番石榴草莓日本柚子慕斯

dishes.en: Vanilla apple Earl Grey Saint Anne
Sea buckthorn mint white magnolia mousse
dishes.zh: 沙棘薄荷白玉兰花慕斯

tips: The provenance of ingredients is stated on every item — Tahiti vanilla, Japanese yuzu etc
Outdoor seating in a planted garden — beautiful on a clear afternoon
French-trained technique applied to unusual flavour combinations

restaurants.address: 锦江区点将台街59号
restaurants.desc: French-Korean aesthetic dessert cafe near Jiuyanqiao. Staff proactively help with photos and provide toy figure props. The tiramisu is made to a classic Italian recipe — arguably the most authentic version in Chengdu.
tips: Staff help with photos and provide props — very accommodating
The tiramisu is made to the classic Italian recipe
Near Jiuyanqiao — a good final stop on an evening walk

restaurants.address: 武侯区檀香山小区2号门旁边
restaurants.desc: Inside a small courtyard next to a residential compound entrance. The AOP butter red bean bread uses certified French AOP butter — the quality difference is immediately apparent. The bakery shares space with a small plant shop.
tips: Inside a residential courtyard — a genuinely local setting
AOP certified French butter in the red bean bread — the quality is immediately apparent
The plant shop next door sells the most beautiful succulents in Chengdu

restaurants.address: 武侯区芳草街17号附2
restaurants.desc: Near Yulin metro with outdoor camping chairs and a street-watching spot. Cakes can be ordered in half-portions — trying two different flavours is encouraged. The black gold chocolate uses 72% dark chocolate cream.
tips: Cakes can be ordered in half portions — perfect for trying two flavours
Outdoor camping chairs face the street — great for people-watching
Near Yulin metro — a short walk from the neighbourhoods best restaurants

restaurants.address: 新都区清源路66号附13号
restaurants.desc: The resident corgi George and silver tabby cat Cream are as much the attraction as the desserts. The pistachio Basque cheesecake has a flowing centre. French and Korean aesthetic with Christmas decorations year-round.
tips: The resident corgi and cat are genuinely interactive — a visit with the pets is part of the experience
The pistachio Basque cheesecake has a flowing centre
Year-round Christmas decorations — uniquely festive atmosphere
